title: AID Test Portfolio — Scheduler Divergence Evidence
$comment: producer: aid-test-schedule-divergence-check.sh (P069 Step 7); consumers: aid-test-divergence-campaign.sh (Step 7), the rollout activation gate (Step 13). Retained, never auto-pruned, never overwritten — one file per invocation, keyed by commit_sha-mode_tested-run_id.
description: Proves (or disproves) that the SAME selected unit set produces identical membership and verdicts whether run sequentially or via the scheduler, on the same commit, inside a fresh disposable clone. run_id MUST be a genuinely collision-safe UUID (never a monotonic counter) — two concurrent invocations against the same commit must never compute the same run_id and silently overwrite each other's retained artifact.

run_id.description: A genuinely collision-safe UUID (RFC 4122 shape) — never a monotonic counter.

catalog_fingerprint_set.description: sha256 over the sorted, newline-joined set of every compared unit's CURRENT runtime.fingerprint — the staleness key the rollout gate (Step 13) checks.

worktree_kind.description: Never 'live' — this check always runs inside a fresh disposable clone, never the live project checkout.

membership_diff.description: unit_ids present in exactly one of sequential_verdicts/scheduled_verdicts. Empty if identical.

verdict_diff.description: Empty if every unit present in both verdict sets agrees.

pass.description: true only if BOTH membership_diff and verdict_diff are empty.

sequential_duration_ms.description: Real, measured wall-clock duration of THIS invocation's own sequential dispatch (the SAME run whose verdicts appear in sequential_verdicts above) — added P069 EPIC 4 whole-diff review: this is the only place a genuinely-measured full-selection scheduled/sequential runtime figure can ever originate, since gate-runtime-baseline's own concurrency_context samples (Step 3) are only ever recorded for a gate actually dispatched through aid-run-gates.sh's own scheduler integration (Step 14), which is scoped to the targeted_tests gate alone — never bats_all or any other quarantined gate whose remediation evidence (Step 15) needs a real scheduled-mode duration.

scheduled_duration_ms.description: Real, measured wall-clock duration of THIS invocation's own scheduled (mode_tested) dispatch.
